source: Completely fabricated public-header example; generated offline by x402-smokecheck/checker.mjs v1.0.1; NO outside user, permission, endpoint or wallet.

report.scope: Unpaid browser-header readiness only. NOT payment verification, spend-control, chain finality, or a paid-response test.

checks.detail: An OPTIONS preflight must succeed without payment or authorization.
OPTIONS must allow the intended browser Origin.
OPTIONS must allow the intended paid request method.
OPTIONS must allow the x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE request header.
A JSON POST preflight must allow Content-Type.
HTTP 402 response must allow browser to read its headers.
x402 v2 priced route should return a PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header.
Browser must be allowed to read PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Without it the price is opaque.
Check whether paid responses also expose PAYMENT-RESPONSE; unpaid 402 alone cannot prove it.
Reflecting per-request Origins should include Vary: Origin to prevent shared cache mistakes.
A priced challenge should not be cached in a shared intermediary.
